heading_path: 16.7  Matters to be included in publication of adverse decision
text: For the purposes of paragraph 175(4)(b) of the Act (which deals with publication of a decision of the Commission not to give a certificate), the publication of the matter must: (a) be in a computer database maintained by the Trade Marks Office; and (b) include a statement to the effect that, subject to the Administrative Review Tribunal Act 2024, application may be made to the ART for the review of the decision to which the publication relates.
title: Matters to be included in publication of adverse decision

units.text: For the purposes of paragraph 175(4)(b) of the Act (which deals with publication of a decision of the Commission not to give a certificate), the publication of the matter must:
(a) be in a computer database maintained by the Trade Marks Office; and
(b) include a statement to the effect that, subject to the Administrative Review Tribunal Act 2024, application may be made to the ART for the review of the decision to which the publication relates.
